bio.text: John Ricottone is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for New York State Assembly District 47 on the Republican, Conservative and Stop Mamdani Party lines, running against Democratic incumbent William Colton.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a high school diploma from John Dewey High School and an associate degree from Ashworth College in 2005, and was retired as of 2026.
